visual_outcome.net_gain: Small positive whole-character tonal integration: the common crown reads cooler steel rather than an isolated warm cream/bronze patch under both held native lights in all three eras. The relative improvement survives profile and rear continuity.
visual_outcome.cost: Some fine mottled/streak variation is quieter, making the crown more uniform. No meaningful new whole, profile, rear, body or feet cost detected in the exact native image packet. This is a perceptual judgment, not a calibrated source measurement.
visual_outcome.not_new_progress: Body and feet improvements belong to earlier retained work; no new Loop03 body/feet gain is claimed.
dominant_remaining_source_gaps: Broad smooth blank helmet-like crown remains bright and bulbous in whole/highlight views; the source has tighter, denser segmented mechanical enclosure.
The open brow/root slot, thick rounded optic seat and sparse cheek returns still prevent coherent source-like head enclosure. The useful deep hook and visible optic remain readable.
Rear and underside head/neck voids and dark shoulder/back gaps remain conspicuous from opposing and rear views.
Repeated softened feather/body relief is less sharp and mechanically layered than the source; large segmented feet remain coarser than source articulation.
Maker and Mechanic appearance separation remains weak; the common gray crown does not establish all three source-era identities.
